notes: Added 5 stories for Clinical Trials Search feature covering schema, core logic, API integration, travel enrichment, and tests.

stories.title: Define Clinical Trial Search Input and Output Schema
stories.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for clinical trial search inputs (condition, location, optional travel params) and normalized output schema including title, phase, summary, eligibility, and locations.

stories.title: Implement ClinicalTrials.gov Search Logic
stories.description: Implement core service logic to query ClinicalTrials.gov API with recruiting filter, parse results, and normalize trial data fields for downstream use.

stories.title: Expose Clinical Trial Search via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate clinical trials service into evaluate_care_facade and expose as callable tool through tool_router with validated inputs and structured response.

stories.title: Add Travel Distance and Duration Enrichment
stories.description: Enhance trial results with optional travel distance and duration using Google Routes API based on user location and trial sites.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trial Search
stories.description: Create tests covering schema validation, API query behavior, response normalization, and travel enrichment including edge cases (no results, missing fields).
